func NewEngine(cfg, providerRegistry, promptRegistry, mcpRegistry, convExecutor, adapterRegistry, toolRegistry) (*Engine, error)
NewEngine adopts the eval orchestrator injected into convExecutor
calling SetEventBus forwards the bus to the evals and eval.completed reach subscribers
NewEngine does not initialize workflow state machine, memory subsystem or runtime hooks; NewEngineFromConfig does
NewEngine params providerRegistry, promptRegistry, mcpRegistry, convExecutor, adapterRegistry, toolRegistry are the components returned by BuildEngineComponents
func NewEngineFromConfig(cfg *arenaconfig.Config, providerFilter ...string) (*Engine, error)
NewEngineFromConfig builds components and engine, then initializes workflow, memory and runtime hooks
NewEngineFromConfig is the constructor the CLI uses
modifying cfg before calling overrides what was loaded from disk

NewEngineFromConfigFile loads configuration from a file (arena.yaml)

func Generate(ctx context.Context, req Request) (*Result, error)
Request fields Source SessionSourceAdapter, List ListOptions, Convert ConvertOptions, Dedup bool, Pack *packspec.Pack
ListOptions fields FilterPassed, FilterEvalType, Expectations, Limit
ConvertOptions fields TaskType, Expectations
Dedup drops sessions with the same failure fingerprint
Pack supplies eval params and declared thresholds the source did not record
type Result struct { Scenarios []*arenaconfig.ScenarioConfig; Skipped []Skipped; Warnings []string; Decisions []Decision; Deduplicated int }
Generate lists, fetches each, optionally dedups, converts each into a scenario
Nothing is printed and nothing is written to disk
Session that fails to load or convert is recorded in Skipped; failure to list is fatal
Each recorded eval produces one Decision
failed recorded verdict asserted with its params; measurement bounded by pack threshold or Expectation asserted with that bound; measurement with no known range reported, not asserted
func WriteScenarios(dir string, scenarios []*arenaconfig.ScenarioConfig) ([]string, error)
